t: This is 39 and 39A Frognal, a house in Camden. It was designed by Richard Norman Shaw, a British architect who worked from the 1870s to the 1900s. He's known for his country houses and for commercial buildings, and he is considered to be among the greatest of British architects. His influence on architectural style was strongest in the 1880s and 1890s, so you're looking at a house from the height of his reputation.
